extracted.intended_audience: USPTO examiners and patent applicants/agents preparing or responding about Sequence Listing XML (WIPO ST.26) for patent applications
extracted.subtask_description: Requirements and examiner form-paragraphs for Sequence Listing XML (WIPO ST.26) compliance in U.S. patent applications, including required statements, substitute specifications, validation, and publication handling. Covers deficiencies, required applicant responses, and helpful tips for generating/validating compliant sequence listings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sequence Listing XML contains errors (¶ 24.20.26)
rubrics_metrics.description: The “Sequence Listing XML” part of the disclosure filed with this application in accordance with 37 CFR 1.831-1.834 has been found to contain an error or errors as indicated on the document 'Computer Readable Form (CRF) for Sequence Listing - Defective'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required response — Applicant must provide: a replacement 'Sequence Listing XML' part of the disclosure (submitted per items 1 or 2), together with: (1) a statement that identifies the location of all additions, deletions, or replacements of sequence information in the replacement 'Sequence Listing XML' as required by 37 CFR 1.835(b)(3); (2) a statement that indicates support for the amendment in the application, as filed, as required by 37 CFR 1.835(b)(4); (3) a statement that the replacement 'Sequence Listing XML' includes no new matter as required by 37 CFR 1.835(b)(5); and (4) a substitute specification in compliance with 37 CFR 1.52, 1.121(b)(3), and 1.125 inserting the required incorporation by reference paragraph as required by 37 CFR 1.835(b)(2), consisting of: a marked-up version of the previously-submitted specification (deletions strikethrough/brackets; insertions underlined), a clean amended specification, and a statement that the substitute specification contains no new matter. Examiner Notes: use only where compliance with 37 CFR 1.831-1.835 is not required for examination or lack of compliance arose during prosecution; must be preceded by form paragraph 24.17.26; may be followed by deficiency paragraphs; use when defective XML was filed and STIC notice sent; may be used when applicant provides a disc in reply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sequence IDs not present in drawings (¶ 24.22.26)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sequences appearing in the drawings are not identified by sequence identifiers in accordance with 37 CFR 1.831(c). Sequence identifiers (i.e., 'SEQ ID NO:X' or the like) must appear either in the drawings or in the Brief Description of the Drawings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required response – Applicant must provide: amended drawings in accordance with 37 CFR 1.121(d) inserting the required sequence identifiers; AND/OR a substitute specification in compliance with 37 CFR 1.52, 1.121(b)(3), and 1.125 inserting the required sequence identifiers into the Brief Description of the Drawings, consisting of: a marked-up previously-submitted specification, a clean amended specification, and a statement that the substitute specification contains no new matter. Examiner Notes: use only where compliance with 37 CFR 1.831-1.835 is not required for examination or lack of compliance arose during prosecution; must be preceded by 24.17.26; use where sequence embedded in drawings without identifier; may be followed by deficiency paragraphs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sequence IDs not present in specification (¶ 24.21.26)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sequences appearing in the specification are not identified by sequence identifiers (i.e., 'SEQ ID NO:X' or the like) in accordance with 37 CFR 1.831(c).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required response – Applicant must provide: a substitute specification in compliance with 37 CFR 1.52, 1.121(b)(3), and 1.125 inserting the required sequence identifiers, consisting of a marked-up copy of the previously-submitted specification, a clean amended specification, and a statement that the substitute specification contains no new matter. Examiner Notes: use only where compliance with 37 CFR 1.831-1.835 is not required for examination or where a lack of compliance arose during prosecution; must be preceded by form paragraph 24.17.26; may be followed by deficiency paragraphs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sequence disclosed in spec/drawings/claims but not in XML (¶ 24.23.26)
rubrics_metrics.description: The application contains sequence disclosures under definitions in 37 CFR 1.831(a)/(b) but fails to comply with 37 CFR 1.831-1.834 (i.e., sequences present in specification, drawings or claims are not included in the Sequence Listing XML).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required response — Applicant must provide: a replacement 'Sequence Listing XML' part of the disclosure (per item 1 or 2), a statement identifying the location of all additions/deletions/replacements in the XML per 37 CFR 1.835(b)(3), a statement indicating support for the amendment per 37 CFR 1.835(b)(4), a statement that the XML includes no new matter per 37 CFR 1.835(b)(5), and a substitute specification in compliance with 37 CFR 1.52, 1.121(b)(3), and 1.125 inserting the required incorporation by reference paragraph as required by 37 CFR 1.835(b)(2) (marked-up and clean versions plus statement no new matter). Examiner Notes: use only where compliance not required for examination or lack arose during prosecution; must be preceded by 24.17.26; examiner should identify sequences missing from the XML that were found in claims/drawings/specification; may be followed by deficiency paragraphs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Missing, defective, or incomplete incorporation by reference paragraph (¶ 24.24.26)
rubrics_metrics.description: The incorporation by reference paragraph required by 37 CFR 1.834(c)(1), 37 CFR 1.835(a)(2), or 1.835(b)(2) is missing, defective, or incomplete.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required response - Applicant must provide a substitute specification in compliance with 37 CFR 1.52, 1.121(b)(3), and 1.125 inserting the required incorporation by reference paragraph, consisting of: a marked-up previously-submitted specification, a clean amended specification, and a statement that the substitute specification contains no new matter. Examiner Notes: use only where compliance not required for examination or lack arose during prosecution; must be preceded by 24.17.26; use when incorporation paragraph is missing/defective/incomplete; examiner should clearly specify how the paragraph is non-compliant; may be used when incorporation paragraph provides erroneous information (e.g., size in KB instead of bytes, wrong file name); may be followed by deficiency paragraphs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment missing statement of no new matter (¶ 24.25.26)
rubrics_metrics.description: The 'Sequence Listing XML' has not been entered into the application because the required statement of no new matter, in accordance with 37 CFR 1.835(a)(4) or 37 CFR 1.835(b)(5), is missing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required response – Applicant must submit a statement that the 'Sequence Listing XML,' identified by the date it was filed, includes no new matter. Examiner Notes: use only where a compliant 'Sequence Listing XML' is not required for examination; must be preceded by 24.17.26; may be followed by deficiency paragraphs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment missing statement of support (¶ 24.26.26)
rubrics_metrics.description: The 'Sequence Listing XML' has not been entered into the application because the required statement of support for the 'Sequence Listing XML' in the application as filed, in accordance with 37 CFR 1.835(a)(3) or 1.835(a)(4), is missing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required response - Applicant must submit a proper statement that indicates the basis for the 'Sequence Listing XML,' with specific references to particular parts of the application as originally filed (specification, claims, drawings) for added, deleted and/or modified sequence data. Examiner Notes: use only where compliance not required for examination or lack arose during prosecution; must be preceded by 24.17.26; may be followed by deficiency paragraphs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sequence Listing XML contains foreign language text (¶ 24.27.26)
rubrics_metrics.description: Language-dependent free text elements within the 'Sequence Listing XML' are not in the English language, as required by 37 CFR 1.833(b)(3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required response - As required by 37 CFR 1.835(d)(2), applicant must provide a translated 'Sequence Listing XML' part of the disclosure in compliance with 37 CFR 1.831-1.834. Examiner Notes: use only where compliance not required for examination or lack arose during prosecution; must be preceded by 24.17.26; use when XML contains foreign text in language-dependent free text elements; may be followed by deficiency paragraphs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment missing statement of location of additions/deletions/replacements (¶ 24.29.26)
rubrics_metrics.description: The 'Sequence Listing XML' has not been entered into the application because the required statement that identifies the location of all additions, deletions or replacements of the sequence information relative to the replaced 'Sequence Listing XML' is missing (see 37 CFR 1.835(b)(3)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required response - Applicant must provide a proper statement identifying all changes in the replacement 'Sequence Listing XML' relative to the replaced sequence data. Examiner Notes: use only where compliance not required for examination or lack arose during prosecution; must be preceded by 24.17.26; use when replacement XML is not accompanied by a statement indicating the location of all additions/deletions/replacements; may be followed by deficiency paragraphs.

rubrics_metrics.name: General effect of compliance with WIPO ST.26 (helpful hints)
rubrics_metrics.description: High-level tips about the implications and scope of compliance with WIPO Standard ST.26 (as implemented by 37 CFR 1.831-1.835).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Key points: Compliance is not required for establishing a filing date. A sequence listing submitted with a new application in compliance is considered part of the specification and contributes to disclosure for 35 U.S.C. 112. Compliance is not per se a new matter issue (see MPEP § 2414.02 and § 2414.03 for adding/amending listings). The international filing date (PCT) can control for national stage submissions. A sequence listing transmitted by the IB for a PCT national phase entry does not require adding an incorporation by reference statement to the specification nor a statement about new matter, nor must it be amended to update bibliographic data such as the 371 number. Sequences prohibited from inclusion in an XML may be presented in the description but should not be associated with a sequence identification number.

rubrics_metrics.name: Which sequences must be included and representation rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Which nucleotide and amino acid sequences must be included in a 'Sequence Listing XML' and how certain residues/representations must be handled.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Amino acid sequences required in the XML include D-amino acids, modified amino acids, and linear portions of branched sequences. Nucleotide sequences required include modified nucleotides, nucleotide analogs, and linear portions of branched sequences. Sequences of <10 nucleotides and <4 amino acids are prohibited in a 'Sequence Listing XML.' Uracil and thymine representation notes (as stated): 'Uracil is represented by “t” in RNA and DNA, and is considered to be a modified nucleotide that requires additional annotation when present in a DNA sequence.' 'Thymine is represented by “t” in RNA and DNA, and is considered to be a modified nucleotide that requires additional annotation when present in an RNA sequence.' Amino acid representations are each one letter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sequence identifier formatting and placement requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for how sequence identifiers must appear in the disclosure and where they may be placed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each sequence disclosed in the 'Sequence Listing XML' must have its sequence identification number associated with 'SEQ ID NO:' or the like designator next to each occurrence within the disclosure (i.e., SEQ ID NO: X). Variations of 'SEQ ID NO:' format (e.g., 'Seq Id No.') are permitted. Parentheses are NOT required; the sequence identifier must be clearly separated from the sequence shown in the specification. Sequences in figures can have 'SEQ ID NO:' either with the identifier in the figure itself OR in the Brief Description of the Drawings (it does not have to be in both places). An intentionally skipped sequence identification number (i.e., an intentionally skipped sequence) is entered as '000'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incorporation-by-reference and bibliographic data requirements for XML (111(a) applications)
rubrics_metrics.description: What statements must accompany a Sequence Listing XML filed in a 111(a) application and different requirements for new/added/amended listings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each 'Sequence Listing XML' filed in a 111(a) application must be accompanied by an incorporation by reference statement that includes the name of the file, the date of creation, and the size of the file in bytes. A 'Sequence Listing XML' filed along with a new application need not be accompanied by any statement about new matter. An added 'Sequence Listing XML' filed after the filing date must be accompanied by a statement that: (1) indicates that no new matter has been introduced; AND (2) identifies the support for each new sequence and sequence-associated data within the application as filed. An amended 'Sequence Listing XML,' including one submitted to address a defective sequence listing (validated as CRFD), must be accompanied by a statement: (1) indicating that no new matter has been introduced; (2) identifying the locations of additions, deletions or replacements of sequence information relative to the replaced listing; AND (3) identifying the support for the additions, deletions or replacements of sequence information within the application as filed.

rubrics_metrics.name: WIPO Sequence tool: authoring, import, validation, and conversion notes (WIPO Sequence & Validator)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on using the WIPO Sequence desktop application to author and validate Sequence Listing XMLs and conversion/import issues with ST.25 to ST.26.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WIPO Sequence provides an authoring function and a validation function to create ST.26 compliant 'Sequence Listing XML' files; the validation function generates a report listing every detected error, the location and detected value, and provides links to the sequence in question. The validation also lists 'warnings' for issues that need human review (e.g., inappropriate organism name). It is highly recommended that a 'Sequence Listing XML' produced by WIPO Sequence be validated after generation. WIPO developed WIPO Sequence Validator for IPOs to verify ST.26 compliance; the USPTO has integrated WIPO Sequence Validator into its internal systems (CRFValidator), so a listing validated by WIPO Sequence has a high chance of acceptance. A Sequence Listing in WIPO ST.25 format cannot automatically be converted into ST.26 because certain data elements required for ST.26 are not present in ST.25; conversion requires additional applicant input. WIPO Sequence can import ST.25 files and generate an Import Report that alerts users to required conversions and entries needing additional input. Annex VI/VII of ST.26 provide guidance to avoid added/deleted subject matter when converting ST.25 to ST.26. Sample XML specimen available in WIPO ST.26 Annex III and at WIPO website.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication handling of Sequence Listing XML by USPTO (size-based)
rubrics_metrics.description: How the USPTO transforms/publishes Sequence Listing XML files based on their size when preparing patent grants and patent application publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The SLIC system transforms an XML into an ASCII text file (via style sheet) for publication. If the ASCII text file produced is under 600 KB, it will be published as part of the specification. If the ASCII text file is 600 KB or more but under 1 GB, it will be processed for separate publication on the Publication Site for Issued and Published Sequences (PSIPS) and the patent/publication will show a page-wide SEQUENCE LISTING statement indicating the listing is available electronically at https://seqdata.uspto.gov and for a fee. If the Sequence Listing XML is 1 GB or larger, exception processing is required: it will not be published as part of the specification nor on PSIPS, but will be published on the USPTO Bulk Data Storage System (BDSS); no transformation to ASCII occurs, and the patent/publication will display a page-wide statement directing users to https://bulkdata.uspto.gov with availability subject to fee per 37 CFR 1.19(b)(3).

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedural/usage notes for examiners regarding sequence form paragraphs
rubrics_metrics.description: Examiner procedural guidance about when to use these form paragraphs and sequencing of form paragraphs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Repeated Examiner Notes across paragraphs: (1) These form paragraphs should only be used where compliance with 37 CFR 1.831-1.835 is not required for examination, or where a lack of compliance with 37 CFR 1.831-1.835 arose during prosecution. (2) Each such form paragraph must be preceded by form paragraph 24.17.26. (3) Specify the particular deficiency and, where relevant, identify sequences missing or defective. (4) The form paragraph may be followed by one or more deficiency form paragraphs. (5) Where specialized issues arise (e.g., national stage PCT matters, bibliographic discrepancies), examiners should contact IPLA or follow the specific examiner guidance included in the paragraph.
